assertions: The official GET /pypi/<project>/<version>/json endpoint returns sampleproject 4.0.0 without authentication.
The exact project identity, Python requirement, MIT license classifier, wheel and source distribution filenames, SHA-256 and BLAKE2b-256 digests match the reviewed fixture.
The response provides an ETag and a consistent X-PyPI-Last-Serial value, and every distribution remains on files.pythonhosted.org.
The normalized output contains no author, maintainer, email, token, cookie, vulnerability details or raw response; alternate API bases, redirects and responses larger than 2 MiB are not accepted.
